name: Kunnin' Plan
text: Once per turn, in your hero phase, a friendly unit wholly within 12" of the general can retreat without suffering mortal damage and can still shoot and charge afterwards.

name: Mork's Eye Pebble
text: Once per battle, in the enemy movement phase, friendly units wholly within 12" of the general have Ward (5+) in the following shooting phase.

name: Egomaniak
text: While another friendly unit is within 3" of the general, each damage point bound for the general moves to that unit on a 4+.

name: Eye-biter Ash
text: Once per battle, in any combat phase, an enemy unit in combat with the general gets -1 to hit, for the phase or, on a roll of 5+, for the rest of the battle.
